en.description:
BANANA.BIKE Watch
The Neon Arcade Racer for Your Wrist

Banana-bending speed - now on Apple Watch!

Dive into a hypnotic neon world and race through an endless arcade challenge, right from your wrist.
Dodge the Bullies designed by real players from all over the world and test your reflexes,
focus, and nerve.

FAST NEON ARCADE ACTION
An intense endless racer with ultra-smooth controls and glowing visuals. Swipe or spin the Digital Crown to switch lanes. Haptic feedback on every banana. Easy to learn. Hard to master.

REAL ENEMIES. REAL PLAYERS.
Every Bully is created by a real person. No generic bots. Only human imagination trying to stop you.

PLAY ANYWHERE. NO PHONE NEEDED.
Quick sessions while waiting, commuting, or just taking a break.
Your wrist, your race.

BEAT YOUR BEST
Track your personal highscore and keep pushing your limits.

Fast. Addictive. Neon.
Ready for the ride?
en.releaseNotes:
Bug Fixes & Performance
• Fixed game speeding up after “Play Again”
• Optimized performance for Apple Watch
• Reduced memory usage
• Redesigned Game Over screen
en.subtitle: Banana-bending speed
